observations: Three photos show large white multifunction office machines wrapped tightly in clear plastic film, stacked in a warehouse-like shop alongside other similar units.
Photo 0 and photo 2 show the word 'RICOH' printed on the machine's front panel.
Photo 1 shows a partially visible label reading 'MP C...' on the top right of an adjacent stacked unit, but the full model number is cropped/unreadable.
All units have multiple paper drawers, a flatbed/ADF top section, and a control panel area, consistent with large-format color copier/printers.
Promotional flyers (unrelated food/snack ads) and a 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' watermark are taped to the machines, not the item itself.
No photo shows the machine powered on, a usage/page counter, a toner level display, or a full clear nameplate with serial/model number.
No photo shows a customs/import sticker or any documentation supporting 'London use' origin.

claims.evidence: No import documentation, shipping label, or UK-market sticker visible in any photo.

claims.claim: MP C4504ex/MP C6004ex multifunction color systems
claims.evidence: Only a partial 'MP C...' label is visible in photo 1 on a neighboring unit; the full model number is cropped and unreadable in all three photos.

claims.claim: Ideal for fast-paced (implying good working condition)
claims.evidence: No power-on shot, test print, or counter screen shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Exact model (C4504ex vs C6004ex) is unconfirmed, and these carry different price tiers.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the nameplate/model sticker on the machine being sold (not a neighboring unit).
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced without this, since the two named models differ materially in value

risks.risk: Working condition unknown; plastic wrap suggests the unit has not been demonstrated powering on.
risks.proof: Video or photo of the machine powered on and producing a test print/copy.

risks.risk: Page/drum/meter count unknown, which affects remaining toner-drum life and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of the machine's usage counter or meter reading screen.

risks.risk: 'London use' grade claim cannot be confirmed, affecting assumed cosmetic/mechanical grade.
risks.proof: Import paperwork, UK compliance label, or shipping manifest photo.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used import, not premium 'UK-grade' stock

risks.risk: Missing or depleted consumables (toner, drum, fuser) not visible under plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photo of open toner compartment showing cartridge levels/part numbers.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial nameplate on the actual unit for sale.
Photo or video of the machine powered on with a test print or copy produced.
Photo of the usage/page counter screen.
Photo of the open toner/drum compartment showing consumable levels.
Any import/customs document or UK compliance sticker supporting 'London use' claim.
response.reason: The seller names two distinct models (MP C4504ex/MP C6004ex) with different market values, but no photo clearly shows the nameplate or model number on the actual unit being sold, so even a worst-case price cannot be fixed without that shot.
